questions.q: What stage is your business at today?
opts: Just starting out, looking for my first clients
I already have clients but want to grow and get organized
I have an established business and want to professionalize it

questions.q: Do you have your own website?
opts: Yes, active and up to date
I have one but it's outdated or incomplete
I don't have a website

questions.q: Does your business show up on Google Maps / Google Business Profile?
opts: Yes, with a complete profile, photos and active reviews
I show up but I don't manage the listing
I'm not registered on Google

questions.q: How do you handle your business's social media?
opts: We post frequently with a strategy
We post when we can, with no plan
No active presence on social media

questions.q: Do you have a logo and a defined visual identity?
opts: Yes: consistent logo, colors and typography
I have a logo but no full visual identity
No professional visual identity

questions.q: How do you receive client inquiries?
opts: Multiple organized channels (WA Business, email, web)
Only personal WhatsApp or Instagram
Only in person or by phone call

questions.q: Do you use a professional email with your own domain?
opts: Yes, email on my own domain (hello@mybusiness.com)
I use personal Gmail or Hotmail for the business
No dedicated email for the business

questions.q: How do you organize clients, orders or sales?
opts: I use a CRM or management software
I use Excel or Google Sheets
From memory or loose notes

questions.q: Do you have a digital catalog or price list?
opts: Yes, online and always up to date
I have something but it's outdated
No digital catalog or pricing

questions.q: Do you invest in digital advertising?
opts: Yes, with a defined budget and strategy
I did it once, with no continuity
No, I've never invested in digital advertising

questions.q: Do you manage customer reviews or testimonials?
opts: Yes, we ask for reviews and respond to them
I have some but don't manage them
I don't have active reviews

questions.q: Do you issue digital invoices or receipts?
opts: Yes, always digitally and organized
Sometimes, or only when asked
No formal receipts currently
